policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Accidental Damage and Optional Glazing Edition
description: Accidental damage claim on the home contents cover. A heavy bowl was knocked off a shelf and fell against a display cabinet. The glass panel in the cabinet door cracked on the impact. The same knock did more than crack the glass. It caught the solid-wood door frame on the way, denting and gouging the timber, and a wooden shelf inside took a hit and was scratched and chipped. So there are really two kinds of damage on the one cabinet: the broken glass pane, which had to be remade to measure and refitted, and the timber parts of the cabinet, the frame and the shelf, which needed repair and refinishing.

lines.2: Installation of the new glass into the frame 1 pcs
lines.4: Repair of dented and gouged solid-wood door frame 1 flat rate
lines.5: Repair and refinish of scratched and chipped wooden shelf | 1 flat rate
